notes.title: Nominate It's Just A Prank for "Outstanding Story-Rich Game"
notes.content:
Hey pranksters and thrill-seekers!

This year has been a wild ride, and It’s Just A Prank wouldn’t have made it this far without all of you. What started as a simple story about two mischievous kids spiraled into a deep exploration of trust, cruelty, and consequences. From the classroom chaos to those tense, heart-stopping moments, your support means everything to us.

If you found the twists, turns, and emotional rollercoaster unforgettable, consider nominating It’s Just A Prank for the “Outstanding Story-Rich Game” award. Let’s show the world how powerful a prank can be—when it’s laced with a little darkness.

Thanks for being part of this journey! 🌟

notes.title: 💌 Our Discord Is Now Open to Everyone!
notes.content:
Yo! ✨  

We’ve decided to make our Discord public, and we’d love for you to join us there. ❤️

👉 https://discord.gg/6rR3mXgq73 👈

This space is for you—to share your thoughts, fan art 🎨, and ideas 💡, or just to hang out and chat about our games and the stories behind them. It’s a place where we can all connect, support each other, and keep the conversation going.

We know a lot of you resonate with the themes we explore, and we’re so grateful for this community. 🥰
Let’s create something meaningful together, one step (or message!) at a time.

Hugs to y’all,
Mnim
